SELECT count(*) n,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.sale_date > r.return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) returned_before_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN ps.subcategory <> 'Garden Furniture' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sold_product_differs_subcat,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned > s.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_gt_sold,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(r.return_ts_utc AS DATE) <> r.return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ts_date_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN w.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cancelled_orders,
 sum(CASE WHEN w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL AND w.status IN ('processing') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) processing_orders
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product ps ON ps.product_key=s.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=s.receipt_id AND s.channel_code='WB'
WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'

SELECT d.fiscal_period_label, count(*) n, sum(quantity_returned) units, count(distinct return_line_id) ids, count(distinct sales_line_id) sl, sum(CASE WHEN d.calendar_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nodate
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
